newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends firm, led by banks, engineers.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends firm, led by banks, engineers.

text.p: Britain's leading share index ended moderately higher on Tuesday as Abbey National lifted the banking sector and a weaker sterling breathed new life into engineering stocks, traders and analysts said.
Food retailers, which benefitted from the currency's scorching rally this summer, due to their high proportion of domestic earnings, fell sharply as investors locked in profits.
The FTSE 100 index finished 14 points higher at 4,876.6, with advances leading declines by a 56 to 41 margin.
